controls.name: Framework Scope and Claim Boundary
controls.objective: Define exact organizational, technical, data, vendor, jurisdictional, and claim boundaries before any framework assertion is released.
controls.implementation: Maintain an approved scope statement, applicability record, exclusions rationale, system inventory, data-flow map, and approved public-claim language.
controls.evidence: Approved scope statement; system inventory; data-flow map; jurisdiction and contractual analysis; applicability decisions; reviewer approval.
controls.procedure: Verify scope completeness, approvals, exclusions, inventory alignment, and claim language against current operations.

controls.name: Identity and Least Privilege Gate
controls.objective: Prevent unauthorized or excessive access by verifying identity, authority, purpose, and minimum required permission before execution.
controls.implementation: Sync Machine evaluates authenticated identity, Authority Matrix permissions, requested action, resource sensitivity, and least-privilege constraints.
controls.evidence: Authority Matrix entry; access decision log; role and permission snapshots; denied-action records; access review approval.
controls.procedure: Attempt authorized and unauthorized operations; verify least-privilege decisions, denial behavior, and evidence generation.

controls.name: MFA Enforcement for Privileged Access
controls.objective: Require strong multi-factor authentication for privileged, administrative, and high-impact access paths.
controls.implementation: Inventory privileged accounts, enforce provider-supported MFA, harden recovery controls, and block or escalate unverified access.
controls.evidence: Privileged account inventory; MFA configuration proof; recovery review; exception records; access logs; verification results.
controls.procedure: Sample privileged accounts and verify MFA, recovery controls, exceptions, and one controlled authentication path per platform.

controls.name: Asset Classification and Data Handling
controls.objective: Classify systems, records, credentials, personal data, and potentially regulated data so handling rules can be applied consistently.
controls.implementation: Assign owner, sensitivity class, data category, approved locations, retention rule, access boundary, and disposal method before use or release.
controls.evidence: Asset inventory; classification decisions; handling rules; retention schedule; access mapping; data-flow and storage-location evidence.
controls.procedure: Sample assets and verify classification, ownership, approved location, access, retention, and disposal fields.

controls.name: Evidence Capture and Integrity Hashing
controls.objective: Create traceable, tamper-evident operating evidence for governed actions, control operation, tests, exceptions, incidents, and releases.
controls.implementation: Every governed action produces a timestamped record with source, actor, action, result, linked object, retention rule, and SHA-256 integrity hash.
controls.evidence: Source event; append-only record; cryptographic hash; timestamp; actor and authority reference; retention and reviewer fields.
controls.procedure: Generate representative events, reconcile source and evidence records, recalculate hashes, and verify missing-evidence release blocks.

controls.name: Control Testing and Reviewer Approval
controls.objective: Prevent unsupported effectiveness claims by requiring a defined test, retained result, exception handling, and reviewer approval.
controls.implementation: Controls cannot advance from EVIDENCED to TESTED or EFFECTIVE without a completed test record, evidence, result, reviewer, and approval timestamp.
controls.evidence: Approved procedure; sample definition; evidence references; result; defects; remediation; reviewer identity and approval.
controls.procedure: Select controls in EVIDENCED state and verify test completeness, evidence traceability, remediation handling, and approval.

controls.name: Incident Detection, Containment and Escalation
controls.objective: Detect suspected security or privacy events, contain impact, preserve evidence, escalate by severity, recover safely, and improve.
controls.implementation: Establish intake, severity classification, containment actions, evidence preservation, communication authority, recovery validation, and post-incident correction.
controls.evidence: Incident record; timeline; detection source; severity; containment and recovery proof; communication approval; root cause; corrective actions.
controls.procedure: Run a tabletop and technical detection simulation; verify classification, escalation, evidence preservation, containment, and closure gates.

controls.name: Vendor Due Diligence and Access Review
controls.objective: Assess vendor security, privacy, data access, contractual obligations, sub-processors, continuity, and offboarding before and during use.
controls.implementation: Classify vendors by criticality and data access; require due diligence, approved terms, access boundaries, review cadence, and termination evidence.
controls.evidence: Vendor inventory; criticality and access classification; diligence record; contracts and data terms; review decision; offboarding proof.
controls.procedure: Sample critical and data-access vendors and verify assessment, contracts, access, sub-processors, review status, and termination controls.

controls.name: Exception Expiry and Reapproval
controls.objective: Ensure temporary control exceptions are risk-assessed, authorized, time-bounded, monitored, and removed or reapproved before expiry.
controls.implementation: Each exception records affected control, rationale, risk, compensating measures, authority, start and expiry dates, review cadence, and closure evidence.
controls.evidence: Exception request; risk assessment; compensating control proof; approval; expiry alert; reapproval or closure record.
controls.procedure: Inspect open exceptions for authorization, compensating measures, future expiry, alerts, and evidence of closure or reapproval.

controls.name: Backup Restore and Continuity Validation
controls.objective: Ensure critical records, configurations, code, and service data can be recovered within approved continuity requirements.
controls.implementation: Define critical assets, backup method, retention, encryption, ownership, recovery objectives, restore procedures, and validation evidence.
controls.evidence: Backup configuration; job logs; retention proof; restore output; recovery timing; integrity checks; exceptions and remediation.
controls.procedure: Perform controlled restores for representative critical assets and verify integrity, recovery timing, defects, and remediation.
